title: One Week in Marrakech | Visit Marrakech Morocco - BAHJA SPIRIT | Official Guide for Travel, Activities and Events
facts: The local tourism board recommends Medersa Ben Youssef, Koutoubia, Bahia Palace and Saadian Tombs.
It identifies Ben Youssef as a former Quranic school and explains that non-Muslims cannot enter the Koutoubia mosque but can visit its gardens.
The page links a medina visit with Jemaa el-Fna, souks and Majorelle Garden.
confidence: official-source; editorial review limited to listed stable facts
notes: Stable place and visitor-planning facts only. Prices, opening hours, event schedules and safety guarantees are deliberately omitted; consult operators for current conditions. The source contains a questionable acquisition date for Majorelle; no acquisition date is used in our guide.
